purpose: Limited synthetic sanity controls; not validation on real reference-image geometry.

parallel.limit: This estimates spatial change in edge angles, not camera calibration. Parallel-line confidence and perspective truth require Claude review; absence of a flag is not proof of orthographic projection.

convergent.limit: This estimates spatial change in edge angles, not camera calibration. Parallel-line confidence and perspective truth require Claude review; absence of a flag is not proof of orthographic projection.

orange-0.palette_source: Product starting accent values, used only for screening; no Part B tone selection.
orange-0.limit: Shade, occlusion and unrelated warm material can split or merge an apparent part. Count is a reproducible palette-mask heuristic, not semantic ownership of the accent.
